items.q: Verified has been a great asset to our recruiting efforts for several years. They have the most complete information in the industry and serve as the foundation for our prospect database.
items.name: Andy Frank

items.q: Verified Athletics has been an amazing addition to our recruiting. Having the real time updates, player stats, and being able to sort by position has allowed us to organize our recruiting in ways we couldn't have done with just the portal itself. We are very thankful for Verified Athletics.
items.name: Sarah Noble
items.role: Head Coach, South Carolina Women's Volleyball

items.q: Verified Athletics helped tremendously in organizing our portal efforts. The ability to filter to your specific needs and get instant updates puts Verified in a class of their own.
items.name: Yolisha Jackson
items.role: Head Coach, South Alabama Women's Basketball

items.q: Verified Athletics is an integral part of our daily operation. Their platform gives our staff trusted information, saves valuable time, and helps us stay proactive throughout every phase of the scouting process. It has become a key resource for TCU.
items.name: Tyler Olker

items.q: Being at a smaller FCS program, our staff may not be as large as other programs but Verified allows us to operate with the efficiency and resources of a larger recruiting department. Being that recruiting is the lifeline of any program, Verified proves its worth throughout the entire year and the customer service is top tier.
items.name: Mike Jasper

items.q: Verified Athletics has been a valuable tool in enhancing Indiana University's recruiting process by providing access to one of the most accurate databases of transfer prospects nationwide. The platform has allowed our staff to quickly identify, evaluate, and track prospects with verified data, saving significant time in the early stages of recruiting. The real-time insights, in-depth scoring metrics, and measurable data have improved the efficiency and precision of our evaluations. Ultimately, Verified Athletics has helped us make more informed decisions and connect with the right players who fit our program.
items.name: Christian Lomeli

items.q: Verified helps us find players who fit our program with speed and efficiency. With help from Verified, we offered 5 transfers, and signed all 5!
items.name: John Lorenzo
items.role: Associate Head Coach, Wright State Women's Basketball

items.q: Using Verified has made every aspect of our recruiting department more efficient — from organizing road plans to identifying and evaluating high school, JUCO, and transfer portal prospects. It has streamlined our entire recruiting process and continues to be an invaluable resource for our staff. Without question, it is the best recruiting tool we have used.
items.name: Hunter Simms

items.q: Verified athletics is involved in our every day operations and recruiting efforts at the University of Maryland. Their forward-thinking and solution based actions, coupled with their easy-to-use platform have been a huge asset to our program.
items.name: Jess Imhof
items.role: Director of Scouting, Maryland Women's Basketball

items.q: Verified Athletics is now an integral part of our transfer portal recruiting process here at UNCG. In this new landscape in college athletics with a high volume of transfers in each window, it's extremely important that we keep up and execute our recruiting process with high impact transfers each year. Verified Athletics helps us do that by giving us key information real time and organizes things in an efficient way, which significantly improves our workflow.
items.name: Christopher Rich

items.q: Verified is a terrific tool that we have utilized going on two years now. Andrew and his staff continue to evolve as well, making their software as functional and useful as possible.
items.name: Brian Pensky

items.q: Verified has been an integral partner in portaling. The software itself has been a great tool in evaluating players, and the team's service has been top notch in advising and customizing based on our needs.
items.name: Kaitlyn Judge
items.role: General Manager, West Georgia Women's Basketball

items.q: Verified Athletics has streamlined our transfer portal process. Using this platform, we are able to be efficient which is a major asset to a college program especially when trying to improve a roster. We appreciate the work Verified does on the front end to save us time and allow us to focus our efforts on evaluation.
items.name: Andrea Morrow

items.q: Verified Athletics has created so many opportunities to refine and make our process more efficient. The site has allowed our program to minor in the transfer portal as well as major in the recruitment of the best players at the right time! Their customer service is second to none as well when needed!
items.name: Danny O'Dea

items.q: We've relied on Verified Athletics as a vital tool when navigating the transfer portal over the last several years. In today's environment with the massive numbers of players entering the portal, a system like Verified Athletics that allows us to quickly search, filter, and compare players across all levels of NCAA Collegiate soccer is invaluable.
items.name: Dane Brenner

items.q: The transfer portal era has become increasingly chaotic. Verified Athletics has helped bring much-needed structure and transparency to the process. It's been a valuable resource in navigating the portal and managing our process in a more organized way.
items.name: Cole Schmitt

items.q: Verified has changed the way we recruit nationally—the ease in which we can access data and contact information for recruits from coast-to-coast has reshaped our out-of-region recruiting and directly led to a more geographically diverse, and talented, football roster. It has been worth every penny!
items.name: Braden Layer

items.q: Verified Athletics has been a valuable tool for us. It simplifies the transfer portal and helps us quickly find players who fit our program.
items.name: Tobias Bischof

items.q: We switched over to Verified last year. The information we receive is thorough and reliable. The staff is easy to deal with. We love the offer tracker feature and the transfer portal information. Glad we made the change.
items.name: Tony Kunczewski

items.q: Verified has completely streamlined how we approach the transfer portal. It allows us to quickly build and compare player lists while staying ahead of the curve when athletes enter the portal. It's been a real game changer for our process.
items.name: Chris Gnehm

items.q: Verified is an excellent tool for our program. Sometimes you feel as a coach there are not enough hours in a day to complete all your work. Verified helps us to stay organized in an area of college sport that has exploded over the last few years.
items.name: Graham Winkworth

items.q: Verified Athletics has been a game-changer for how we navigate the transfer portal. Having all of a player's information centralized, combined with the ability to quickly filter and immediately make contact, gives us a real advantage in identifying and connecting with the right players early in the process.
items.name: Michelle Lenard

items.q: We've had a really positive experience working with Andrew and Verified Athletics. The platform makes it easy to evaluate transfers efficiently by keeping all the information we need in one centralized location. The variety of tools available helps our staff stay organized and collaborate effectively, which has streamlined our overall process. Just as importantly, the product continues to evolve, and the customer service has been outstanding. Verified Athletics has become an integral part of how we manage our recruiting workflow.
items.name: Christopher Fox

items.q: In the dynamic world of the transfer portal, Verified has been instrumental streamlining our process to organize and evaluate talent effectively and efficiently. In simple terms, we spend more time looking at the right players for our program.

items.q: Amount and quality of contact information and data is everything. Verified has provided this more accurately than any other recruiting tool we've used.

items.role: Head Coach, North Central College Football

items.q: Verified Athletics has streamlined our process in the transfer portal. It has helped us really organize our workflow and be more efficient when scouting players.

items.q: Verified has changed the way we are able to recruit. With their program we are able to identify transfers that fit what we are looking for and in turn focus on transfers who are realistically interested, saving us valuable time.

items.q: Verified has been a great tool for our football program. Both the high school and transfer portal information has been extremely valuable to our recruiting efforts.

items.q: Verified Athletics has been a tremendous asset to our program, helping us stay organized and fully informed across every aspect of the portal. The platform is incredibly easy to use, which has allowed our staff to navigate it efficiently without a steep learning curve. What really sets the experience apart, though, is the level of communication and support—Andrew has been outstanding. He's been consistently responsive, proactive, and committed to making sure we're getting the most out of the platform, which has made adoption seamless for our entire program.

items.q: Verified has been a great tool for us as we evaluate potential transfers. Being able to sort for specific statistics or positions streamlines our work and saves valuable time for our staff.

items.q: Shane, and the crew at Verified have been great for CUNE football and the impact that the portal notifications have had for our program have been huge. They are service-minded and have been absolutely great to work with and get to know!

items.q: Verified is a great way to sort through and identify the recruiting needs of a program. The customer service is first class and I have been very excited to use the program to identify the right prospects in a timely manner.

items.q: Verified Athletics is an easy-to-use platform for tracking and initiating contact with players in the transfer portal. At the University of Wyoming, it has helped us immensely by providing real-time updates on athletes who meet our specific recruiting parameters as soon as they hit the portal.

items.q: Verified Athlete allows us to navigate efficiently through the portal process by providing all of the necessary info at the click of a button.

items.q: Verified has greatly improved our entire recruiting process. It has been a great tool for us to identify and evaluate student athletes. Most importantly has allowed staff to work much more efficiently.

items.q: Verified has been great at helping us be efficient with our effort in navigating the portal and the company itself has been brilliant to work with.

The service that Andrew and his team provide is second to none in helping us as a program navigate the transfer portal. The platform is user friendly and a must-have tool for anyone incorporating transfers into their recruiting scheme.
